newsitem.title: USA: Nova says knows not why shares tumble.
newsitem.headline: Nova says knows not why shares tumble.

text.p: Nova Corp said in a prepared statement that it is unaware of any reason for the sharp decline in its stock price Thursday.
By midafternoon on the New York Stock Exchange, the shares were off 3-1/2 to 23, or more than 13 percent, and more than 121,000 shares changed hands, about twice the average daily volume.
Earlier in the trading day, the shares fell to an all-time low of 21-1/4.
Nova is an Atlanta-based provider of transaction processing services and related software to small- to medium-sized merchants.
